item.title: Panama Canal to cut daily ship traffic as drought worsens from El Nino
item.description: The Panama Canal will limit daily vessel traffic from September 3, the Pnama Canal Authority said Thursday, as a severe drought fuelled by El Nino depletes water supplies needed to operate the vital trade route.
